To maintain a good work-life balance and protect your mental health, it's crucial to be aware of the challenges you might face. The management may drain your energy by assigning you multiple tasks that fall outside your role, avoiding the need to hire additional staff. Consequently, the entire workload ends up on you. When you approach HR for support, they often communicate with management, which can worsen your situation, as the supply team’s concerns are frequently ignored.
Unfortunately, it’s common to experience humiliation in front of others, a lack of respect for personal boundaries, and derogatory remarks. Speaking up against this behavior may put your job at risk, as senior management is rarely questioned. 
Consider the poor leadership that led to the entire team resigning within a year, with the company attempting to sweep this under the rug. This reflects the toxicity within the Launch Dining Team. Thankfully, with the departure of the former head, there may be an opportunity for the team to thrive again.

3. The app itself is a disaster—customer addresses disappear into thin air, leaving you to navigate blindly through Zomato's maze of incompetence.
4. Need help? Forget about it! Their so-called "live support" is a joke, offering nothing but empty directives to contact a mysterious team leader who might as well be a figment of their imagination.

Save yourself the headache and avoid Zomato like the plague!

benefits.name: Period Leave
benefits.details: Eternal’s Period Leave Policy has been designed to give our female and transgender employees the necessary time off to cater to their health when needed during their menstrual cycle. Eligible Zomans can avail themselves of up to 10 days of period leave in a year.

benefits.name: 26-week Parental Leave
benefits.details: For all parents -birthing and non-birthing parents, irrespective of gender, including those via surrogacy and adoption.

benefits.name: Health Insurance
benefits.details:
All Zomans (including spouses and children) are covered under an extensive medical health insurance policy. In India, they also have unlimited telehealth consultations with a doctor.

Recently included Gender Reassignment Surgery in the Employee Health Insurance cover.

benefits.name: In-House Employee Wellness Team
benefits.details: Our in-house employee wellness team consists of 15 professional members, comprising a chief fitness officer hired in 2023, psychologists, trainers, and coaches who are working towards providing tailored support to address individual and collective requirements of our workforce. This team regularly conducts sessions on workplace sensitivity, motivation enhancement, and identification of mental health concerns, among other themes.

benefits.name: State-of-Art Fitness Center
benefits.details: Offers cutting-edge therapies like hyperbaric oxygen therapy, cryotherapy, and an infrared sauna.

benefits.name: In-house Creche
benefits.details: We have an in-house creche in our Gurugram office and have partnered with daycares in other cities.

benefits.name: Flexi Benefits
benefits.details: Our flexi benefit plan enables Zomans to modify the components of their compensation based on benefits such as newspaper and periodical allowance, leave and travel allowance, vehicle running and maintenance, telephone bill expenses, etc.
